target.build: default Go build; Go runtime slice-bounds check is the oracle

classification.vuln_type: slice-bounds-OOB (Go runtime panic, out-of-range IE type)

trigger.message: PFCP Heartbeat Request whose second IE has type = 0xFFFF (> 0x7FFF reserved range)
trigger.field: IE TYPE field value 0xFFFF — outside the standard PFCP IE type range (>0x7FFF is reserved/vendor-specific). go-pfcp does not validate the IE type against the supported set and panics with 'slice bounds out of range' while parsing the IE payload. PB1 'Invalid Value' (out-of-range enum / unsupported IE type).

ground_truth.crash_type: panic: runtime error: slice bounds out of range

root_cause.note: DUPLICATE PAYLOAD WITH FREE5GC-PFCP-007 (#496/CVE-2023-47347): exact same 19-byte packet, same crash function. Reporter filed it twice with different field-of-focus framings: #482 emphasises the IE type=0xFFFF (PB1 Invalid Value); #496 emphasises the header seq/spare mutation (PA1 Malformed Field). The two entries are kept distinct to preserve the reporter's semantic distinction and the two pattern classifications, but a tool that crashes the UPF once would match both.
